findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] The server-side condition this test checks - sensitive data stored without encryption - is not met by the schema. Credentials are persisted only as one-way derivations (User.password an argon2id hash, User.reset_password_code a keyed HMAC-SHA256 under OTP_HMAC_KEY), so inspecting the database yields nothing an attacker can replay. No serialized-object or pickled-blob column exists, which is what the TA276 amendment directs a tester to look for. The client-device half of the procedure does not apply: this is a server-side FastAPI service with no mobile client in the repository | verdict=pass confidence=high
